newsitem.title: USA: Florida drunk driver gets 37 years for killing six.
newsitem.headline: Florida drunk driver gets 37 years for killing six.

text.p: A Florida man who killed a woman, her two children and three step-children when he crashed while driving drunk last Christmas has been sentenced to 37 years in jail.
Broward Judge Paul Backman sentenced Scot Naidus on Friday. Naidus was convicted in October on six counts of manslaughter and drunk driving.

The Alexander family were driving home from a trip to Santa's Enchanted Forest fun fair in Hollywood on Dec. 8 last year when Naidus smashed into them at an intersection. Experts estimated he was travelling at 72 mph (115 kph) where the posted limit was 45 mph (70 kph).
Mark Alexander survived the crash but his wife Sharon and his five children, aged between five and 12, were all killed.
"The judge did what he had to do, he could never sentence him to enough time," Alexander said after the sentencing.
"This will bring about a little bit of closure but the pain is not going to go away."
